question: Bhanu is the sister of Chirag. Aryan is the father of Bhanu. Chirag is the brother of Dewan. Dewan is the husband of Esha. How is Esha related to Aryan?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b02115387156e02316bfb1dd95fcf89921e131b2ebba984f145a37f06b22e5d9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/244b40ec5141680735bb186bf4cda919080894e99215fe2bad01b014f012f011.png] 

Clearly, Esha is daughter-in-law of Aryan.

Hence, ‘**Daughter in law**’ is the correct answer.
